Question: How many ways are there to place \(3\) indistinguishable red chips, \(3\) indistinguishable blue chips, and \(3\) indistinguishable green chips in the squares of a \(3 \times 3\) grid so that no two chips of the same color are directly adjacent to each other, either vertically or horizontally?
